END-TO-END 100% MIT HUMAN-AGENT GIT KANBAN, VISUAL OFFICE & VERIFIABLE RUNTIME STACK (L1 ➔ L4)

2. Multi-Provider Agent Office (munder-difflin ★9.7k): Coordinate Claude Code, Codex, Grok & Gemini agents using existing flat-rate subscriptions.
3. Graphical OpenClaw Desktop (ClawX ★7.5k): Give business analysts & PMs a zero-terminal desktop GUI to monitor and steer OpenClaw agents.
4. Durable Approvals & Run Records (open-multi-agent ★7.0k): Gate production side-effects behind durable approvals & verifiable audit records.
